body.condition: The complete labeled roster \(\mathcal R_i\), its size \(N_i\), and every roster variable entering assignment or response models are observed before \(A_i\) and are included in \(B_i\).

novel.justification: A closed enrollment registry with prespecified baseline forms records every eligible label and every design or follow-up predictor before cluster assignment. This contract is empirically auditable and separates outcome nonresponse from unobserved recruitment.
